title: Factorized function x domain vector code
hypothesis: On a synthetic procedure x domain task bank, factorized function x domain Mirror coefficients preserve heldout target NLL while using >=20% fewer actual payload bytes than a generic pooled PCA coefficient table at equal rank.
physical_object: one frozen GPT-2 model and one shared residual intervention site at block 6
mirror_coordinate: procedure factor x domain factor codes plus an explicitly charged per-combination product code; heldout claims only count when all paid coefficients are included
logical_multiplicity: unseen combinations of four procedures and four domains
controls: generic pooled PCA basis with flat coefficients

development.allowed: Validate tokenizer, task semantics and direct-ICL validity only. If direct ICL is <=12.5% in any development world, do not open fresh; mark NOT ESTABLISHED and redesign as a new MA amendment. Rank=4, block=6, factor split and all gates fixed a priori.

paid_objects: all generic or factorized FP16 coefficients
per-combination product/task coefficients for all registered logical functions, including heldout combinations

success_gate: Development direct ICL must exceed 12.5% in both worlds. Then direct ICL exceeds chance in every fresh world; factorized intervention mean target NLL <=1.05 x explicit-delta NLL; and serialized factorized payload <=0.80 x generic PCA payload at fixed rank/quality, counting all per-combination coefficients. Otherwise FAIL/NOT ESTABLISHED as specified.
failure_gate: Direct ICL is at/below chance in any fresh world, intervention fails to improve query-only NLL, or factorized representation misses quality/byte gate.
boundaries: Synthetic token transformation screen only, not natural language performance or causal head-specific Function Vector evidence.
No model weight updates; task prompts define the behaviors.
Factor combination count is not capacity; heldout task behavior and actual bytes decide.
